design.name: 鼯 (giant flying squirrel thunder scout)
design.role: 雷系机动：雷暴信标 / 鹰眼·裁决→雷目 / 凌空（二段跳 + 滑翔）
design.brief: A nimble anthropomorphic Chinese GIANT FLYING SQUIRREL (鼯鼠) thunder scout and Mohist gadgeteer. Big dark glossy eyes with a white eye ring, short rounded ears, a short muzzle, chestnut-brown fur with a cream belly and face, a long flat fluffy tail. A furred gliding membrane runs from each WRIST down to each ANKLE (never between the fingers), shown as a soft drape like a short cape along the flanks. Wears a leather aviator cap with brass goggles pushed up, an indigo Mohist (墨家) tunic with a utility harness, copper-coil wrist gadgets, and a small thunder-drum (雷鼓) beacon clipped to the belt glowing electric cyan-violet. Soft leather boots. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four separate fingers, completely free of the membrane.
design.weapon: a long slim bronze rail rifle with copper coils crackling with cyan-violet lightning, mid-glide with the membranes spread wide
